playwright.browserBinaryPolicy: Playwright-managed binaries only; no system-browser override is accepted by this workflow.

execution.how: Official Playwright Docker image bind-mounted the repository at /work; isolated HOME=/tmp and npm_config_cache=/tmp/npm-cache; PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=/ms-playwright; ran npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund, npm run build, then node scripts/browser-verification.mjs (npm run browser:verify equivalent) inside the container.
execution.mobileSafariNote: mobile-safari is Playwright WebKit with iPhone 13 device emulation only. Chart zoom on Mobile Safari uses labeled public API chart.zoom (API zoom), not native pinch-to-zoom, because Playwright rejects mouse.wheel on mobile WebKit.

details.method: Temporary non-committed Playwright config using Playwright-managed browsers; Next.js example deps installed inside the container; visual-regression review captures excluded (2 tests).
details.note: Chromium and Firefox managed-browser Studio functional suites passed 21/21 each in this probe. WebKit and mobile projects failed multiple cases. This does not replace or expand the official Studio Chromium claim, and is not part of the standalone 70-test matrix.
